name: Practice 3 Ralph Loop Hooks
description: Claude hooks configuration for automated task validation and progress tracking

PostToolUse.name: validate-progress
PostToolUse.command:
bash -c '
if [ -f fix_plan.md ]; then
  completed=$(grep -c "\[x\]" fix_plan.md || echo 0)
  total=$(grep -c "\[" fix_plan.md || echo 0)
  if [ $total -gt 0 ]; then
    percentage=$((completed * 100 / total))
    echo "📊 Progress: $completed/$total tasks ($percentage%)"
  fi
fi
'
PostToolUse.description: Display progress percentage after fix_plan.md edits

PostToolUse.name: detect-all-done
PostToolUse.command:
bash -c '
if grep -qi "ALL.DONE\|✅.*done" fix_plan.md; then
  echo "🎉 ✅ ALL DONE signal detected!"
  echo "⏹️  Ralph loop will terminate after this iteration"
else
  echo "⏳ Continuing to next iteration..."
fi
'
PostToolUse.description: Alert when ALL DONE signal is detected

PostToolUse.name: validate-proverb-format
PostToolUse.command:
bash -c '
if grep -q "원문:" proverbs.md 2>/dev/null; then
  count=$(grep -c "원문:" proverbs.md)
  echo "✅ Found $count proverbs in correct format"
else
  echo "⚠️  No proverbs found yet"
fi
'

PreToolUse.name: check-iteration-limit
PreToolUse.command:
bash -c '
if [ -f .ralph-state.json ] 2>/dev/null; then
  iteration=$(jq .iteration .ralph-state.json 2>/dev/null || echo "?")  
  echo "📍 Current iteration: $iteration/30"
fi
'
PreToolUse.description: Show current iteration before reading ralph-loop.sh

notes.setup: Place this file in the practice-3-ralph-harness directory
notes.activation: Claude Code will automatically detect and apply these hooks
notes.manual-setup: Or copy to ~/.claude/hooks/practice3.json and configure in settings.json
